title: How much would you pay for easy, stable 2D animation generation?
author: Standard_Buy6885
selftext: If there is a stable solution for generating 2D animations, would you be willing to pay for it? Is $0.30 per animation acceptable?

comments.author: phil9l
comments.body: I'd pay a lot, but nobody was able so far to make really good animations. Chatgpt can make you image into sprite sheet. There are solutions for pixel art simple animations.

comments.author: Plourdy
comments.body:
$0.30 per animation is insanely cheap if you could actually achieve what is advertised. 

You need to conquer many issues with generation - consistency, hallucinations, and then a myriad of lower level problems

comments.author: No_Surround_4662
comments.body: Show me good animation. I’ve seen shitty 2d pixel art ‘walk cycles’ where characters are doing the robot. Anything above pixel art is usually rigged. You very rarely get large spritesheets because they aren’t functional, most 2d games that are vector use something like Spine for rigging.

replies.author: Hullefar
replies.body: It's definitely possible, but it takes way too long to do for $0.30, at least any method I've tried.

comments.author: pepperoni92
comments.body: $0.30 is definitely a reasonable price. I’d even pay a different rate based on frame rate.

comments.author: Clear_Mess_8082
comments.body: depends on the quality and length, tbh. $0.30 per animation could add up fast, especially when you can generate static images for free using stable diffusion on sites like image-upscaling.net.

comments.author: wanderingandroid
comments.body: Specifically if it was Spine animations? I know the company I work for would be really interested. However, I'm working with the dev team on creating a tool that will rig assets and then animate them.

comments.author: JazzyJulie4life
comments.body: Free. It’s AI for fucks sake. Why would I pay something that isn’t human ?

replies.author: brocolongo
replies.body: Energy cost + time invested in workflow production.

replies.author: brocolongo
replies.body: \+ knowledge. Just forgot about that one

replies.author: Still_Ad9431
replies.body: Because you don't know how to use AI. If you don't want to pay, then learn how to use it by yourself

comments.author: Deaf-Leopard1664
comments.body:
AI can't even generate exactly same sprite twice, on the very same prompt.

AI can't even produce traditional pixel art, it looks like weird voxel interpretation of 'pixels' when you zoom in. 

AI is at least smart enough to understand what an SNK arcade fighter character implies, just once again, is horribly non-usable.

replies.author: brocolongo
replies.body: AI can generate exactly same sprite twice, on the very same prompt. Just lock the seed generation instead of being totally random.  AI can do all that stuff you just need the to study more :)

replies.author: Deaf-Leopard1664
replies.body: I just realized I'm clearly gunning for 16-32 bit arcade fighter/beatem'up sprite animation... I'm sure the OP is not even referring to that, and is talking about Flash animation type of crap.

comments.author: DisasterNarrow4949
comments.body:
It depends.
- What if the animation generates bad? Would I need to play again? Would there be a retry function for free? Or is the generation so good that it may not even be necessary? 
- What kind of generation is it being generated? Is it sprite animation? Is it skeleton/rigged?
- Do I have full commercial use over the generation?

comments.author: Byamarro
comments.body:
I'd pay 1$ for let's say fully animated isometric character spirtesheet.
All directions. And then, while keeping the same character I would want to be able to add new animations to it.

comments.author: sandacz_91
comments.body:
$0.30 sounds like a really good price. I'm the creator of [pixie.haus](https://pixie.haus), where I offer sprite animations. With the highest package ($60), you get 150 animations—that’s about $0.40 per animation. For sprite work, the best model I’ve found so far is Kling, and I pay $0.056 per second of animation on Replicate.

https://i.redd.it/ypykqy97svxe1.gif

comments.author: lordpoee
comments.body: $10 a month, unlimited access. That's all I'd pay for any service.
